name: redeemid/plan-card
title: Shopify Plan Card
description: A membership plan or product with its live Shopify price and a buy button that goes straight to Shopify checkout. Works without JavaScript and without Shopify's own plugin; signed-in customers arrive at checkout already signed in.

attributes.label: Shopify product
attributes.help: Search your Shopify products by title. The plan card shows its live price and sells it.

attributes.label: Variant ID (optional)
attributes.help: Leave empty to sell the first available variant.

attributes.label: Selling plan ID (optional)
attributes.help: Sell on a subscription or other selling plan. The card lists the product's plans in the editor. Left empty, the card sells a one-time purchase, or the first plan when the product is subscription-only.

attributes.label: Heading
attributes.help: Leave empty to use the product title from Shopify.

attributes.label: Description
attributes.help: Leave empty to use the product description from Shopify.
